commands.name: server

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite existing files in the output  directory.

options.name: --no-playground
options.description: Exclude the /playground showcase pages,  producing a lean project. Included by default.

options.name: --no-restore
options.description: Skip the automatic `dotnet tool  restore` after generation. By default, dorn restores local tools (e.g.  dorn.cli) so `dotnet dorn <verb>` works immediately.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory for the generated project.  Defaults to ./<name>.

options.name: --theme
options.description: Boot-default theme: slate (default), rose,  neutral, linear, primer, or lightning. Prompted interactively if omitted and the session is interactive.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: Name of the project to generate.
